cohort: Eighteen pediatric patients under 18 years of age with type 1 diabetes (T1D).
finding: Pediatric patients with T1D and mild COVID-19 showed worsening glycemic control during infection, which returned to pre-infection levels within 2 weeks, and continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) was more effective than multiple daily injections (MDI) in maintaining stable glycemic control during COVID-19.
